objective: This folder is empty. Build a small notes service in Python using only the standard library (nothing to install). Start it with `python server.py --port PORT`; it also accepts `--data FILE` (default: notes.json in the current folder) and listens on 127.0.0.1. It is a JSON API: POST /notes with {"title", "body"} creates a note and returns 201 with the note, which has an integer `id`, `title`, `body` (default "") and `created`. The title is required: a non-empty string of at most 200 characters, and a body, when given, is a string; otherwise, or for a body that is not valid JSON, answer 400 with {"error": "..."}. GET /notes returns all notes as a JSON array, newest first. GET /notes/ID returns one note; PUT /notes/ID updates the given title and/or body (same rules) and returns the note; DELETE /notes/ID returns 204. An unknown note is 404. Every response except 204 is JSON. Notes survive a restart, and ids are never reused. Add your own tests.
